states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
states.description: UE is not registered with the 5G network

excerpts: The UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED shall initiate the registration procedure for initial registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF

states.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
states.description: UE is successfully registered with the network

excerpts: Upon receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the UE shall reset the registration attempt counter, enter state 5GMM-REGISTERED and set the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.

states.name: 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
states.description: The AMF has initiated a 5GMM common procedure.

excerpts: If a 5G-GUTI or the SOR transparent container IE is included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the AMF shall start timer T3550 and enter state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED as described in subclause 5.1.3.2.3.3.

states.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
states.description: UE is registered but with limited service

excerpts: the UE shall enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and shall search for a suitable cell according to 3GPP TS 38.304 [28] or 3GPP TS 36.304 [25C] with the updated "CAG information list";

states.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
states.description: UE is registered but needs to perform PLMN selection

excerpts: the UE shall enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and shall apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the updated "CAG information list";

states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
states.description: UE is deregistered and does not have a SUPI

excerpts: If the UE is not performing initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN, the UE shall delete the list of equivalent PLMNs (if any) or the list of equivalent SNPNs (if any), and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI.

states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
states.description: UE is deregistered but attempting registration

excerpts: The UE shall abort the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, reset the registration attempt counter and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION.

states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
states.description: UE is deregistered and in limited service

excerpts: the UE shall store the current TAI in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
states.description: UE is deregistered and needs to perform PLMN selection

excerpts: For 3GPP access the UE shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and perform a PLMN selection according to 3GPP TS 23.122 [5], and for non-3GPP access the UE shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and perform network selection as defined in 3GPP TS 24.502 [18].

states.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
states.description: UE is deregistered and no cell is available

excerpts: The UE shall enable the E-UTRA capability if it was disabled, disable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access (see subclause 4.9.2) and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE.

states.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
states.description: UE has initiated registration and is awaiting response

excerpts: If the UE receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message from the network in state 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED the de-registration procedure shall be aborted and the initial registration procedure shall be progressed.
